records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Works
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-07-05), so there's some momentum, but no key milestone in 6 days, no invite sent, and Sam hasn't replied to three Wrenfield emails (email:89ec4f16, email:c0e3dc18, email:12b0e875). Open API pagination ticket (tick_c27225f478ec) is an unanswered blocker to API-based usage.

draft.subject: Re: API pagination
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for your patience on your pagination question -- to confirm: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you don't need to fetch everything at once. Your ticket stays open until you're happy with the answer, so do tell me if the accounts endpoint behaves differently than you expect.

I also noticed you've got a project started. If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through what you're building and make sure Wrenfield fits the way your team works.

Best,
Chidi
